name: Condition
description: That a creature is in a state the rules name: poisoned, grappled, frightened. The states themselves are codes.

mapsTo.comment: The same shape and the same meaning: a subject, a coded state, when it took hold and when it lifted. FHIR binds clinicalStatus and verificationStatus to clinical value sets, which have no counterpart here; severity carries a level rather than a code.
That reference lists the states; this records one holding.
